open_questions: Source: Afton HiTEC 5748 PDS 'HiTEC® 5748 Non-Dispersant Olefin Copolymer Viscosity Modifier', printed edition '05/23' (© 2023 Afton Chemical Corporation; PDF created 2023-07-28), retrieved as the Internet Archive original-bytes copy captured 2024-10-05 (SHA-256 18edefceb198a43701b7eb17544599a71c6137199f6e3967800cf3f6ff0cee3b), p.2. Afton's live site blocks automated access. The archive only names HiTEC 5748 inside other bulletins (DL2-13692.pdf HiTEC 12360, 07/20; DL2-15568.pdf HiTEC 12210M, 04/22).

Printed typical characteristics with no field in the component templates (PDS 05/23, p.2): Appearance: Clear to slightly hazy greenish tan viscous liquid; Specific Gravity @ 15.6/15.6°C: 0.855; Flash Point, °C (PMCC): 135 min.; Color, ASTM D1500: 3.0 max.; Kinematic Viscosity @ 100˚C, cSt: 1100; Dilute Viscosity @ 100°C, cSt: 11.55 (dilution, reference oil and dose not stated). Handling Information: Max Handling Temp: 250°F (120°C); Shelf Life: 36 months @ 10 – 40 °C.

Application (PDS 05/23, p.2): 'recommended for use in various Engine Oils, selected Off Road, and Grease applications'; listed uses: licensable PCMO applications from API SL to OEM applications such as MB 229.5, licensable HDEO applications from API CH-4 to OEM applications such as MB 228.51, JASO compliant for MCO applications from API SG to API SN quality, selected off-road applications, and grease applications 'to provide structural stability and reduce soap content'. Recorded here, not as compatibility restrictions; secondary function left Missing.

Active content, carrier identity/share, compatibility restrictions and TBN/Ca/Mg/P/Zn/Mo are not printed; left Missing and not inferred. The 03/18 edition says the product is based on a solid polymer, but gives no polymer content.

Older Afton editions retrieved from the Internet Archive (original bytes, not cited as sources): PDS 07/11 (http://www.aftonchemical.com/ProductDataSheets/Engine%20Oil/HiTEC-5748_PDS.pdf, snapshot 2012-05-03, SHA-256 ee8581a8...); PDS 03/18 (HiTEC-5748_PDS_1.pdf, snapshot 2023-02-02, identical to the 2019-07-13 capture, SHA-256 3bfb7f0d...); PDS 04/21 (HiTEC-5748_PDS_2.pdf, snapshot 2023-01-28, SHA-256 f291807c...). Typical characteristics differ between editions (edition differences on properties without a template field): 07/11 Specific Gravity 0.865, Flash Point (PMCC) 155 min., Viscosity @ 40°C 15000 cSt, Viscosity @ 100°C 1140 cSt, Color 5.0 max.; 03/18 0.855, 135 min., 1100 cSt @ 100°C, Color 5.0 max., Thickening Power @ 100°C 6.55; 04/21 and 05/23 0.855, 135 min., 1100 cSt @ 100°C, Color 3.0 max., Dilute Viscosity @ 100°C 11.55 cSt. The recommended dosage table is identical in all four editions. The record uses the 05/23 edition.
Identity: HiTEC 5748A is a separate Afton grade with its own PDS (HiTEC-5748A_PDS.pdf); it has no inventory row (identity review ID-08). No 5748A data is used here.
